card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
**Overview**

My services have been retained to recruit a **Plant Manager** for one of the top mid-sized U.S. dairy manufacturing companies. Opportunity located in desirable Midwest **metropolitan community**.

The Plant Manager will report to the **COO** and oversee management-level associates and approximately **60 hourly employees** within a state-of-the-art, modern, recently expanded manufacturing facility. The successful candidate must have a strong track record of achieving long-term results in **budgeting, P&L, inventory control, quality, labor efficiency, and overall plant performance**. The candidate should also be highly knowledgeable in plant equipment and manufacturing operations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **4-5 years of Ice Cream, Yogurt, Novelties, or might consider Dairy Manufacturing experience**
* Minimum **5 years of upper-level management experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field is preferred, but not required
* Demonstrated ability to improve efficiency, profitability, quality, and overall plant performance

**Compensation:**

**$130,000–$170,000 base salary**, potentially flexible depending on experience, plus a **20% bonus opportunity**. A relocation package is available.

If you are an **over-achiever looking for a top-level Plant Management opportunity with a successful company that continues to grow**, I would welcome the opportunity to speak with you confidentially. Please Reply-Share Your Status. Send your resume and contact information to:

**Wade Palmer and Associates, Inc.**

**417-860-5607**

**wep@job-recruiters.com**

Pay: $130,000.00 - $170,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person
